title: Neurons and computers integrate information only in time

statements.text: Nearly all examples of integrated information, including neuronal processing and conventional computing, are integrated only in time: outputs are correlated with many inputs, but no single physical state holds the integration. Neural networks on their own therefore cannot physically integrate conscious information.

sources.quote: the information integration is implemented in time, rather than space
Neural networks, on their own, cannot be responsible for physically integrating conscious information
